name: Drinking water and wastewater
description: Loss or contamination of drinking-water and wastewater services, including resulting health, sanitation and environmental consequences.

name: Education, assessment and pupil welfare
description: Harm to education, assessment, learner progression and pupil welfare, including the integrity of qualifications and safeguarding information.

name: Electricity generation and supply
description: Loss, degradation or unsafe operation of electricity generation, distribution and supply, including its effect on dependent critical services.

name: Emergency response and civil contingencies
description: Reduction in the government’s ability to prepare for, coordinate and respond to emergencies, major incidents and civil contingencies.

name: Environment, biosecurity, agriculture, fisheries and food safety
description: Damage to habitats, biodiversity, agriculture, fisheries, animal health, food safety and the natural resources on which the islands depend.

name: Healthcare, social care and safeguarding
description: Harm to the delivery and safety of healthcare, public health, social care and safeguarding services, including reliance on accurate clinical information.

name: Policing, justice, custody and evidential integrity
description: Harm to policing, investigations, courts, custody and legal processes, particularly where evidence, due process, liberty or public protection is affected.

name: Road, public transport, aviation, port and navigation safety
description: Loss, disruption or unsafe operation of roads, public transport, aviation, ports, shipping and navigation services.

name: Telecommunications, digital government and public records
description: Loss or compromise of telecommunications, digital government, authoritative public records and the information infrastructure supporting public services.

name: Delivery of public and administrative services
description: Impairment of government’s ability to provide routine, important or essential public and administrative services accurately and on time.

name: Embarrassment, distress and personal standing
description: Personal emotional, social or professional harm caused by disclosure, error or misuse, including embarrassment, distress and damage to standing.

name: Fuel, food, medicines and essential supplies
description: Disruption to the importation, storage or distribution of fuel, food, medicines and other supplies essential to island life and government operations.

name: Identity, entitlement and official records
description: Loss of confidentiality or reliability in identity, status, entitlement, licensing and other authoritative records used to establish rights or obligations.

name: Life, safety and liberty
description: Consequences for human life, physical safety, health and lawful freedom, including injury, illness, death or unjustified restriction of liberty.

name: Personal, business and island economy
description: Financial and economic harm to individuals, households, businesses, markets or the wider island economy.

name: Privacy of citizens and staff
description: Harm arising from unauthorised access to or disclosure of citizens’ or staff members’ personal, sensitive or special-category information.

name: Public confidence, democratic government and external relations
description: Damage to public trust, democratic legitimacy, effective government, political stability or the Misty Isles’ relationships with external partners.

name: Public finances, revenue and assets
description: Direct loss of public money, revenue or assets, or loss of confidence in budgeting, accounting, payments, debt and financial stewardship.
